Economist, Global Poverty Department, The World Bank · PhD candidate, Justus Liebig
University Giessen · [github.com/EBukin](https://github.com/EBukin)

## Profile

Land and poverty economist with a decade of research and operational experience in Ukrainian
land markets, institutions, and valuation. Peer-reviewed work on farmland pricing, rental-market
efficiency, and land valuation and taxation; analysis code adopted by the Ukrainian State Cadaster
as the basis for regression-based agricultural land valuation. Fluent across survey, administrative,
and geospatial data (R, Python, Google Earth Engine, PostGIS). Dual Ukrainian and German national.

## Experience

### Economist (ETC2), The World Bank — Washington DC · Feb 2025 – present
Global Poverty Department. GeoPov (geospatial × microdata); fiscal microsimulations at the
Micro-Modelling Lab; EU poverty mapping; land-economics research and technical assistance to the
Ukrainian State Cadastre. Leads Bank-wide adoption of AI-assisted coding (600+ staff trained).

### Lecturer, Justus Liebig University Giessen — Germany · Jan 2020 – Dec 2024
Land markets and institutions, farm restructuring, rental-market efficiency in Ukraine, land-policy
evaluation in Kazakhstan. Introduced and taught two MSc econometrics courses. CGE modelling on the
BMBF-funded ROCHADE project.

### Economist (STC), The World Bank · Mar 2018 – Jan 2025
Fiscal incidence analysis, geospatial analysis, and capacity building, delivered as reusable
software: devCEQ, devPTIpack, lassopmm, and country Shiny applications.

### Researcher, IAMO — Halle (Saale), Germany · Oct 2017 – Dec 2019
Land and labour relations in Ukrainian agriculture. Led the second wave of the IAMO Farm Survey in
Central Asia (600 responses).

### Trade Economist / Statistician, FAO of the UN — Rome · Sep 2014 – Jan 2018
WTO policy briefs, OECD-FAO Agricultural Outlook meat chapter, AGLINK-COSIMO modules; IPCC-compliant
GHG estimation and the first emissions-intensities database in FAOSTAT.

## Education

### PhD, Agricultural Economics — JLU Giessen · 2024 – Dec 2026
Land privatization and pasture quality in southern Kazakhstan. Supervisor: Prof. Dr. Martin Petrick.

### MSc, Rural Development — Erasmus Mundus (Ghent, Humboldt, Pisa, Pretoria) · 2013 – 2015
Magna cum laude, 130 ECTS.

### MSc & BSc, Economic Cybernetics — NULES of Ukraine · 2008 – 2013
Summa cum laude.
